name: 书剑·经典 (ShuJian Classic)
english_description: A later, more complete snapshot from the same core engine as Book and Sword World (bxsj), inheriting its sect, apprenticeship, and beginner-friendly training systems; ships with multi-platform production driver binaries indicating it once ran as a live server. New characters are personally guided through the basics by an escort NPC at the martial hall.
